items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: So we sitting out in the lobby talking, and Jimmy Rushing, Dickie and I

ctx.x: that they call (unintelligible). Basie was in Philadelphia at that particular time, and we were -- Dickie Wells and I went around to a place called the Pet Shop, where all the musicians and performers used to go and you could buy whiskey there, you know, under the table. So it was on a Sunday, and so I was living upstairs because I was staying there, and (unintelligible) had a room on the first floor in the back. So Don said to me, said, 'Happy, why don't you come on to the back, said, we got a bottle.' 'Oh, no,…

So Jimmy Rushing, was sitting there talking with Jimmy, so Dickie and I went around to the Pet shop, the Pet Shop, and we came back. So we sitting out in the lobby talking, and Jimmy Rushing, Dickie and I, so all of a sudden Don Byas came running into the lobby, hey -- hey, man, they bombed Pearl Harbor. I said, you got to be kidding.
